doc.title: Dave Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, Wilton, Connecticut, November 21, 2001

title: Closing thanks
summary: Brubeck says he listens daily to archive recordings; Rowe thanks him and plans to attend the 85th birthday.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: God. Every day I listen to this old stuff from the archives at Pacific. And it gets me so emotional to hear.

Well you have a legacy of music that is unprecedented I think, and the kind of person you are seems to go along with it in perfect tandem. So I just want to thank you for your time today. It’s been an honor for me to be with you and I wish you the best and I’m going to book my flight to London for your 85th birthday.
Oh I hope I make it.
I’m sure you will. Thank you very much.
